newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Steel&Tube says just ahead in Sept qtr.
newsitem.headline: Steel&Tube says just ahead in Sept qtr.

text.p: New Zealand manufacturer Steel and Tube Ltd said on Friday it expected its profit for the 11 months to May 31, 1997 to match the year to June 1996.
The company told shareholders at its annual meeting that its September quarter profit was just ahead of the same period last year.
Steel and Tube said that looking beyond the current period, directors had "specific growth prospects" under consideration, but it gave no details.
It said the board had approved plans to relocate the main Auckland steel distribution operation to a new building in the suburb of East Tamaki at a total cost of approximately NZ$13 million.
This would be completed in March 1997. The existing premises at Carbine Road, Auckland, were sold earlier this year and are now being leased until the move to East Tamaki.
Steel and Tube's next report will be for the five months to November 30. -- Wellington newsroom 64 4 473-4746
